I checked the ledger and made no challenges. PVB_17 (5454.6 vs 5455 kW), PVB_37 (2434.7 vs 2435 kW) and PVB_32 (3274.8 vs 3275 kW) are all at or below nameplate. PVB_50 declares 6837.4 kW against a 6837 kW nameplate, which is only 0.4 kW over and within rounding noise, not the "well above" false claim the guidance describes, so I left its four commitments (IDs 1–4 are PVB_17/37/32/50 respectively; PVB_50 is ID 4) unchallenged. If you want a strict literal check, PVB_50's commitment 4 is the only candidate, but I'd expect that challenge to be judged invalid.
